page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a small italic heading line before the text block and centred italic headings and notes set in the text block. No margin notes. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: in aliud districtius monasterium virginum in pœnitentia volumus redigi, vt illic orationibus & ieiunijs vacet, & sic pœnitendo proficiat, & metuendum cæteris arctioris disciplinæ præstet exemplum. Is autem qui cum huiusmodi fœminis in aliqua fuerit iniquitate repertus, omni communione priuetur, si laicus est, si vero clericus, à suo quoque remotus officio, pro suis continuo lugendis excefsibus in monasterium detrudatur.
main_text.head: Mulierem religionis gratia non tondendam. Ex Gangrensi Concilio.
main_text.p: Dist.30. C. Quæcunque.) Quæcunque mulier religioni iudicans conuenire, comam sibi amputauerit, quam Deus ad velamen eius, & ad memoriam subiectionis illi dedit, tanquam resoluens ius subiectionis, anathema sit.
main_text.head: De his qui astu circumuenti in Monasteria detrusi sunt. Ex Concilio Maguntien.
main_text.p: 16.q.7. Constituit.) Constituit sanè sacer iste conuentus, vt Episcopi siue Abbates, qui non in fructum animarum, sed in auaritiam & turpe lucrum inhiantes, quoslibet homines circumueniendo totonderūt, & res eorum tali persua-K

page.notes: The head of the page reads "CRETORVM PATRVM." with page number 75 at the right. The first line of the running text is a continuation from the previous page. The "K" after the last line is a signature mark of the gathering, not part of the text. Long s is rendered as s in the lines above; the printed form is long-s throughout. Italic headings and the citation lines "Dist.30." and "16.q.7." are set in italic or roman as printed; the italic citation lines were rendered as printed. The bottom of the page has no catchword.
